may_A_ref_suv.text: Reference values: mediastinal blood pool SUVmax 1.57; liver pool SUVmax 2.37.

may_A_no_comparator.text: No DICOM data of previous PET studies were provided for comparison.
highlight: No DICOM data of previous PET studies

may_A_s8_size.text: Cystic formations in the liver - the largest in SVIII / SIV up to 6.2 x 4.0 cm

may_A_rmass_size.text: and in SV / SIV up to 13.5 x 10 cm, ametabolic, with single calcification patterns along the periphery; associated with the past treatment of the known GIST.

may_A_calcifications.text: ametabolic, with single calcification patterns along the periphery
highlight: single calcification patterns along the periphery

may_A_activity.text: the cystic formations in the liver also show no activity - the changes correspond to the state after chemotherapy; at present no active tissue or "fresh" patterns are found. PET negative.

may_A_cardia_formation.text: Under the cardiac part of the stomach a similar cystic formation up to 3.3 x 2.8 cm; without reliable metabolism.

may_B_overall.text: The known predominantly cystic residual masses in the liver without significant change in size

may_B_rmass_change.text: the dominant one in the right lobe has slightly decreased from 15 to 13.5 cm

may_B_activity.text: As on the previous imaging, they show no significant increase in activity, including the peripheral components

may_B_nodule_s8.text: however, in the nodule in segment 8 there is a new "mural" spherical dense nodule 11 mm in size, without a noticeable corresponding significant focal increase in activity.

may_B_no_new.text: No new separate hypermetabolic foci were found in the liver.

may_B_nodule_conclusion.text: Compared with 03/2025, further slight decrease of the inactive residual masses of the liver and stomach; appearance of a new mural nodule in the dominant liver mass, but metabolically inactive (possibly due to haemorrhage); further follow-up is advisable.
highlight: new mural nodule in the dominant liver mass

jun_A_ref_suv.text: Reference values: mediastinal blood pool SUVmax 1.41; liver parenchyma pool SUVmax 1.99.

jun_A_liver_cc.text: Liver: compensatorily enlarged, craniocaudal size of the right lobe up to 18.7 cm (13.05.2025 - craniocaudal size up to 17.9 cm)

jun_A_lesions_stable.text: the parenchyma contains ametabolic lesions of hypodense density, stable in size

jun_A_rmass_size.text: Sg5/6/7/8 is occupied by a massive lesion up to 14.4 x 10.4 x 14.1 cm (ax+cor)

jun_A_s7sat.text: Sg7: a satellite lesion up to 1.0 x 1.0 cm

jun_A_s8_subcapsular.text: Sg7/8, subcapsular, up to 6.3 x 4.3 cm

jun_A_s58.text: on the Sg5/8 border, a small lesion up to 0.6 x 0.6 cm

jun_A_s4a7.text: on the Sg4a/7 border, up to 0.6 x 0.6 cm

jun_A_llesion_size.text: on the Sg2/3 border, a lesion along the left portal vein, 4.5 x 3.6 cm

jun_A_llesion_portal.text: on the Sg2/3 border, a lesion along the left portal vein, 4.5 x 3.6 cm

jun_A_s4b.text: Sg4b: a small lesion up to 0.4 x 0.4 cm

jun_A_gallbladder.text: The gallbladder is not enlarged, compressed by the adjacent liver parenchyma
highlight: compressed by the adjacent liver parenchyma

jun_A_gastric.text: along the lesser curvature a hypodense ametabolic lesion persists, of stable size up to 4.3 x 3.3 x 4.4 cm (ax+sag), with increasing calcifications in its structure.

jun_A_conclusion.text: Compared with the PET-CT of 13.05.2026, the picture of the known gastrointestinal stromal tumour (GIST) of the stomach and of the metastatic liver involvement shows no reliable negative dynamics.

jun_A_caveat.text: the absence of marked metabolic activity does not exclude the presence of residual tumour tissue
highlight: does not exclude the presence of residual tumour tissue

jun_B_sizes_stable.text: The known foci and masses in the liver are, on the whole, of stable size
highlight: on the whole, of stable size

jun_B_mural_enhancing.text: however, along their walls, in particular in the largest one in the right lobe, there are new nodular elements with notable enhancement
highlight: new nodular elements with notable enhancement

jun_B_activity.text: and the appearance of partly focal, moderately increased activity, moderately above the liver pool

jun_B_llesion_suv.text: which is best seen at nodule 42 in the left lobe, with uptake up to SUVmax 3.2 (adjacent parenchyma SUV 2).

jun_B_no_new.text: No new separate similar active or suspicious nodules were found.
highlight: No new separate similar active or suspicious nodules

jun_B_ducts_vessels.text: No signs of bowel obstruction, ascites, hydronephrosis, bile-duct dilatation or thrombi of the large vessels.

jun_B_conclusion.text: New mural components with moderate activity in the liver lesions, raising suspicion of a return of viable tumour elements of the GIST metastases.
highlight: New mural components with moderate activity

jun_C_technique.text: The study was performed after intravenous injection of the radiopharmaceutical, without intravenous and without oral contrast.
highlight: without intravenous and without oral contrast

jun_C_known_lesions.text: The known hypodense lesions are again seen in both lobes of the liver.
highlight: in both lobes of the liver

jun_C_rmass_activity.text: A large lesion in the right lobe of the liver with peripheral FDG uptake, which is somewhat more pronounced on the present study.

jun_C_rmass_size.text: The size of the lesion is about 15 x 10 cm

jun_C_rmass_change.text: The size of the lesion is about 15 x 10 cm; on the previous study about 11-12.5 cm.

jun_C_llesion_size.text: The lesion in the left lobe of the liver, about 42 x 36 mm

jun_C_llesion_change.text: The lesion in the left lobe of the liver, about 42 x 36 mm - without significant change in size

jun_C_llesion_activity.text: however, the intensity of FDG uptake has now increased.
highlight: the intensity of FDG uptake has now increased

jun_C_ducts_portal.text: The intrahepatic bile ducts are not dilated. The portal vein is patent.

jun_C_adrenal.text: The right adrenal gland is compressed by the liver, without mass lesions and without pathological FDG uptake.
highlight: right adrenal gland is compressed by the liver

jun_C_gastric.text: The known lesion in the gastric wall with calcifications, without significant change in size - about 37 x 31 mm.

jun_C_conclusion_activity.text: Metabolic progression of the liver foci, especially of the lesion in the left lobe
highlight: especially of the lesion in the left lobe

jun_C_conclusion_rmass.text: as well as enlargement of the large lesion in the right lobe of the liver, whose metabolic activity has also somewhat increased.
highlight: enlargement of the large lesion in the right lobe

fed_llesion_between_veins.text: The biggest problem is the metastasis in the left lobe of the liver, between the vessels - between the left hepatic vein and the left portal vein.
highlight: between the left hepatic vein and the left portal vein

fed_llesion_lhv.text: No, it has no feeding vessel; it partly encircles the left hepatic vein.
highlight: partly encircles the left hepatic vein

fed_llesion_lpv.text: And it lies intimately against the portal vein of the left lateral section, segments 2 and 3.
highlight: lies intimately against the portal vein of the left lateral section

fed_llesion_s3_branches.text: ...the left hepatic vein and the segment III branches. Then there is the option of removing the whole of segment III
highlight: the left hepatic vein and the segment III branches

fed_s1_not_left.text: the metastasis in the Spiegel lobe - which your radiologist describes as being in the left lobe, but it is in fact segment I
highlight: it is in fact segment I

fed_dark_on_ct.text: This tumour is not hypervascular. It is dark on CT.

fed_rmass_volume.text: It's 13... and it occupies the right lobe.

sep_K_known_lesions.text: In the liver, the previously known multiple ametabolic lesions persist

sep_K_rmass_size.text: the largest 98 x 148 mm in the right lobe

sep_K_rmass_change.text: the largest 98 x 148 mm in the right lobe - previously 14.4 x 10.4 mm

sep_K_activity.text: with ingrowth of metabolic activity along the contour and within the structure of some of them, of high intensity, SUVmax up to 4.9
highlight: along the contour and within the structure of some

sep_K_llesion_active.text: with a metabolic size in the left lobe up to 35 x 54 mm (confluent)

sep_K_s8_active.text: and up to 15 x 24 mm within the structure of the ametabolic area in S8.

sep_K_gastric.text: Along the lesser curvature an FDG-negative lesion persists, closely apposed to the tail of the pancreas, with signs of calcification, measuring 43 x 32 mm (previously 4.3 x 3.3 cm).

sep_K_conclusion.text: PET/CT signs of an increase in metabolic activity in multiple foci of liver-parenchyma involvement compared with the PET/CT of 19.06.2026, which is characteristic of progression of the underlying disease.
